name: pnpm Discord Bot
author: kohanmathersmcgonnell@gmail.com
description: Runs a Node.js Discord bot managed with pnpm, from a git repository or uploaded files. Works with monorepos: set App Directory to the bot's folder. Put the bot's secrets in a .env file in that folder. Dependencies are installed on every start, inside the runtime image, so native modules always match its Node version.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
apt-get update -qq
apt-get install -y -qq git ca-certificates > /dev/null

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

if [[ -n "${GIT_ADDRESS}" ]]; then
  REPO="${GIT_ADDRESS}"
  if [[ -n "${USERNAME}" && -n "${ACCESS_TOKEN}" && "${REPO}" == https://* ]]; then
    REPO="https://${USERNAME}:${ACCESS_TOKEN}@${REPO#https://}"
  fi
  if [[ -d .git ]]; then
    echo "[egg] repository already present, pulling"
    git config --global --add safe.directory /mnt/server
    git pull --ff-only
  elif [[ -z "$(ls -A | grep -vx '.ptero')" ]]; then
    echo "[egg] cloning ${GIT_ADDRESS}"
    if [[ -n "${BRANCH}" ]]; then
      git clone --single-branch --branch "${BRANCH}" "${REPO}" .
    else
      git clone "${REPO}" .
    fi
  else
    echo "[egg] server folder is not empty and not a git repository; skipping clone"
  fi
else
  echo "[egg] no repository set; upload the files with the file manager or SFTP"
fi

echo "[egg] installing pnpm ${PNPM_VERSION}"
rm -rf .ptero/pnpm
mkdir -p .ptero/pnpm
npm install --silent --no-audit --no-fund --prefix .ptero/pnpm "pnpm@${PNPM_VERSION:-12}"

cat > .ptero/start.sh <<'START'
#!/bin/bash
# Written by the pnpm bot egg installer. Reinstall the server to update it.
set -e
cd /home/container
PNPM=/home/container/.ptero/pnpm/node_modules/.bin/pnpm

if [[ "${AUTO_UPDATE}" == "1" && -d .git ]]; then
  echo "[egg] pulling latest changes"
  git pull --ff-only || echo "[egg] git pull failed; starting the version already here"
fi

APP="/home/container/${APP_DIR:-.}"
if [[ ! -f "${APP}/package.json" ]]; then
  echo "[egg] no package.json in ${APP}; check the App Directory variable"
  exit 1
fi
cd "${APP}"

if [[ "${INSTALL_ON_START}" == "1" ]]; then
  "${PNPM}" install --frozen-lockfile
fi

export HTTP_PORT="${HTTP_PORT:-${SERVER_PORT}}"
exec "${PNPM}" run "${START_SCRIPT:-start}"
START
chmod +x .ptero/start.sh
echo "[egg] install finished"

variables.name: Git Repository
variables.description: Repository to clone on install (https URL). Leave empty to upload files yourself.

variables.name: Git Branch
variables.description: Branch to clone. Empty = the repository's default branch.

variables.name: Git Access Token
variables.description: Personal access token for private repositories. Stored in .git/config.

variables.name: App Directory
variables.description: Folder holding the bot's package.json, relative to the repository root (e.g. TwitchAnnouncer). Empty = root.

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: Pull the latest commit on every start (1 = on, 0 = off).

variables.name: Install On Start
variables.description: Run pnpm install --frozen-lockfile on every start (1 = on, 0 = off).

variables.name: pnpm Version
variables.description: pnpm version or range to install. Reinstall the server after changing it.
